ST45.basis: WHO: second toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal-lateral to the lateral corner of the second toenail. Nail geometry is approximate (nail length set from typical toenail size); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

SP1.basis: WHO: great toe, medial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal-medial to the medial corner of the toenail. Nail geometry is approximate (nail length set from typical toenail size); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

LR1.basis: WHO: great toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal to the lateral corner of the toenail. Nail geometry is approximate (nail length set from typical toenail size); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

GB44.basis: WHO: fourth toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal to the lateral corner of the toenail. Nail geometry is approximate (nail length set from typical toenail size); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

BL67.basis: WHO: little toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 f-cun proximal to the lateral corner of the toenail. Nail geometry is approximate (nail length set from typical toenail size); 0.1 f-cun taken as 0.2 cm.

LR2.basis: WHO: dorsum of the foot, between the first and second toes, proximal to the web margin, at the red/white flesh border. Placed 0.85 cm proximal to the bottom of the web cleft.

ST44.basis: WHO: dorsum of the foot, between the second and third toes, posterior to the web margin, at the red/white flesh border. Same construction as LR2.

GB43.basis: WHO: dorsum of the foot, between the fourth and fifth toes, proximal to the web margin, at the red/white flesh border. Same construction as LR2.

ST43.basis: WHO: dorsum, between the second and third metatarsals, in the depression proximal to the second MTP joint. Midway between the two shafts, 1.2 cm proximal to the 2nd metatarsal head.

ST42.basis: WHO: dorsum, at the joint of the base of the second metatarsal and the intermediate cuneiform, over the dorsalis pedis artery. Placed at the base of the 2nd metatarsal on the bone drawing.

LR3.basis: WHO: dorsum, between the first and second metatarsals, in the depression distal to the junction of their bases. Midway between the two shafts, 1.1 cm distal to the bases.

GB41.basis: WHO: dorsum, distal to the junction of the bases of the 4th and 5th metatarsals, lateral to the 5th extensor digitorum longus tendon. Midway between the two shafts, 1.05 cm distal to their bases.

GB42.basis: WHO: dorsum, between the 4th and 5th metatarsals, in the depression proximal to the 4th MTP joint. Midway between the two shafts, 1.4 cm proximal to the 4th metatarsal head.

ST41.basis: WHO: anterior ankle, in the depression at the centre of the front surface of the ankle joint, between the extensor hallucis longus and extensor digitorum longus tendons. Placed midway between the two malleoli (estimated) on the ankle line.

KI1.basis: WHO: sole, in the deepest depression when the toes are flexed - about the junction of the anterior third and posterior two thirds of the line from the heel to the web margin between the 2nd and 3rd toes. Placed on that line (web margin = bottom of the 2nd/3rd web cleft).

SP2.basis: WHO: great toe, in the depression distal to the first MTP joint, at the red/white flesh border. Medial view: 1.0 cm distal to the 1st MTP joint centre, on the red/white flesh border (midway between the dorsal and plantar skin lines). Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

SP3.basis: WHO: medial foot, in the depression proximal to the first MTP joint, at the red/white flesh border. Medial view: 1.1 cm proximal to the 1st MTP joint centre, on the border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

SP4.basis: WHO: medial foot, antero-inferior to the base of the first metatarsal, at the red/white flesh border. Medial view: 0.4 cm distal to the 1st-metatarsal base, on the border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

SP5.basis: WHO: medial foot, antero-inferior to the medial malleolus, midway between the navicular tuberosity and the prominence of the medial malleolus. Medial view: midpoint of the two drawn landmarks (both positions estimated). Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

KI2.basis: WHO: medial foot, inferior to the tuberosity of the navicular, at the red/white flesh border. Medial view: directly below the drawn navicular tuberosity, just under the border line. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

KI3.basis: WHO: posteromedial ankle, in the depression between the medial malleolus and the calcaneal tendon. Medial view: at the level of the malleolus tip, midway between the malleolus' posterior border and the tendon's anterior border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

KI4.basis: WHO: medial foot, postero-inferior to the medial malleolus, superior to the calcaneus, anterior to the calcaneal tendon. Medial view: between KI3 and KI5, against the tendon's anterior border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

KI5.basis: WHO: medial foot, 1 B-cun inferior to KI3, anterior to the calcaneal tuberosity. Medial view: exactly 1 B-cun (2.1 cm) vertically below KI3. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

KI6.basis: WHO: medial foot, 1 B-cun inferior to the prominence of the medial malleolus, in the depression below it. Medial view: exactly 1 B-cun (2.1 cm) vertically below the malleolus tip. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

LR4.basis: WHO: anteromedial ankle, medial to the tibialis anterior tendon, anterior to the medial malleolus; midway between SP5 and ST41. Medial view: midpoint of SP5 and ST41 (the ankle-front point, drawn at the ankle crease). Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL60.basis: WHO: posterolateral ankle, in the depression between the lateral malleolus and the calcaneal tendon. Lateral view: at the level of the lateral-malleolus tip, between its posterior border and the tendon. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL61.basis: WHO: lateral foot, distal to BL60, lateral to the calcaneus, at the red/white flesh border. Lateral view: 1.7 cm below BL60 on the lateral face of the calcaneus. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL62.basis: WHO: lateral foot, directly inferior to the prominence of the lateral malleolus, in the depression between its inferior border and the calcaneus. Lateral view: 1.0 cm directly below the malleolus tip. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL63.basis: WHO: lateral foot, distal to the anterior border of the lateral malleolus, posterior to the tuberosity of the 5th metatarsal, in the depression below the cuboid. Lateral view: 1.2 cm posterior to the drawn 5th-metatarsal tuberosity, just above the border, below the cuboid. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL64.basis: WHO: lateral foot, distal to the tuberosity of the 5th metatarsal, at the red/white flesh border. Lateral view: 0.6 cm distal to the tuberosity, on the border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL65.basis: WHO: lateral foot, in the depression proximal to the 5th MTP joint, at the red/white flesh border. Lateral view: 1.0 cm proximal to the 5th MTP joint, on the border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

BL66.basis: WHO: little toe, in the depression distal and lateral to the 5th MTP joint, at the red/white flesh border. Lateral view: 0.45 cm distal to the 5th MTP joint, on the border. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.

GB40.basis: WHO: anterolateral ankle, in the depression lateral to the extensor digitorum longus tendon, anterior and distal to the lateral malleolus. Lateral view: 1.55 cm anterior and 0.45 cm below the drawn malleolus tip. Also drawn on the dorsal/plantar silhouettes (body views only) as a projected border point.
